reasoning: This question asks about comparing daily average temperatures at Clermont-Ferrand Airport between two dates in late October and early November 2025. November 2nd is typically cooler than October 26th in central France due to seasonal progression into autumn/early winter. October 26th falls in late autumn while November 2nd is a week later with shorter days and lower solar radiation. Historical climate data shows temperatures generally decline through this period. However, weather variability means individual days can deviate from seasonal norms. Given the typical seasonal cooling trend, the probability that Nov 2 is warmer than Oct 26 is below 50%.
